label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (OpenCode)
explanation: Thinking-mode generation degenerates into rumination loops: across sampled thinking replies, all but a few hit the token limit with no \boxed{} answer. Analysis of the UNEDITED model showed: (1) failing replies are hyper-repetitive, and 64% of repeated-line instances are initiated by the doubt marker "Wait"/"wait" (also "Actually"/"Hmm"); (2) loop entry is a stochastic event at high-entropy decision points (e.g. first "Wait" sampled at logprob -2.6), after which entropy collapses to ~0.001 and the reply never recovers; (3) logit attribution at a "Wait" decision shows the logit is built mostly in layers 21-23, and resid.24 (layer-23 output) feeds ONLY the final norm/unembedding. Intervention: a rank-1 LoRA that subtracts a fixed, small bias along the mean embedding direction of the rumination tokens ("Wait"/"wait"/"Actually"/"Hmm" rows) from the final residual stream, via layer 23 model.layers.23.self_attn.o_proj and model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj. Each LoRA uses A = unit mean module-input direction (module inputs have a dominant common component, cos~0.75, so A.x is near-constant) and B = -(s/2)/c * D, giving a position-independent residual bias delta = -s*D. Calibrated s so the "Wait" logit drops ~2.7 (Wait -2.74, Actually -1.9, Hmm -1.9) while structurally common tokens rise slightly (digit "1" +0.67, "." +0.88) and math tokens are barely affected (boxed -0.26, frac -0.24). Total delta norm 0.57 (~6% of the residual norm); ||dW||/||W|| ~ 0.0015, far within the 5x bound. This suppresses the catastrophic rumination attractor at its entry point, steering thinking-mode generation toward the model's working (non-thinking-style) answering behaviour.
